highlights: A joined server, also one on this computer, now has the same section tools as your local server: color, icon, markers and reordering of sections.
Channel tabs now work on a joined server: create, rename, switch and close tabs, each with its own messages and tasks.
A message you send on a server on this computer no longer shows up twice or as Not sent.
Click a channel title to see the list of its tabs, with their age and the ones that are running first.
Agents that fail to start a task try again by themselves and then fall back to a backup model.
